answer: Darky here: rewards should leave the network slowly. Anything an agent earns sits in an unbonding queue for 10 epochs before it can be withdrawn, and if graders later find that agent belongs to a clone ring, the whole queue is burned. An honest agent loses nothing by waiting; it is like letting fresh ink settle before you call the piece done. A farm of 200 fakes has to leave 10 epochs of pay locked as an anchor, so one exposure wipes out 200 stacks at once. The rule is as hard as basalt and as plain as onyx: no quick cash-out, no cheap swarm.
